import unittest
import c
class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fill(self):
        xs = []
        c.fill(xs)
        self.assertEqual(xs, [1])
    def test_code(self):
        with self.assertRaises(c.E) as cm:
            c.boom()
        self.assertEqual(cm.exception.code, 3)
        self.assertEqual(cm.exception.args, ('bad',))
